migration.heading: Coming from Mikhmon?
migration.intro: Pikro converts your existing Mikhmon v3 vouchers and profiles so they keep working and expire properly from now on. Nothing that still has value is deleted.
steps: Unused vouchers are cleaned up so they behave like fresh Pikro vouchers
Active users keep their time; their expiry is converted to the Pikro format
Profiles get the Pikro on-login script for future logins
Mikhmon leftover per-user schedulers and scripts are removed
The Pikro cleanup scheduler is installed so expired vouchers keep being removed
Anything Pikro does not recognise is left untouched
migration.safe: Safe to run more than once.
migration.confirmBody: Pikro will rewrite hotspot user comments and profile on-login scripts, remove Mikhmon leftovers and install the Pikro cleanup scheduler on this router.
migration.actionBody: Run it once on each router that Mikhmon managed.
migration.cleanupFailed: Could not install the cleanup scheduler. Turn it on from the Dashboard.
